scene_analysis.scene_overview: A city street view of a tall apartment building with a white umbrella and a tree in front of it. The building has a beige facade with balconies and windows. There is a small garden area in front of the building with a few trees and bushes. A black fence surrounds the garden area. The street is paved with asphalt and there are no cars parked along the curb. The sun is shining brightly, casting shadows on the sidewalk.
